setupBody.message: Open the Umete app to finish setup before using the Safari extension.

badgeOption.message: Badge the Umete icon on pages with forms it can fill

badgeNote.message: Umete checks each page you open for forms, on your device only. Safari will ask you to allow Umete on all websites.

debugLogNote.message: Logs can include page URLs and form labels. Review them before sharing; Umete never sends them automatically.

loggingOff_ios.message: Logging is off. In the Umete app, turn on AI Matching → Enable logging for bug reports, then reproduce the problem.
